scope: Partial MR-06: committed data image verification, durable engine-marker publication and recovery. MR-06 remains IN_PROGRESS.
environment: macOS-26.5.2-arm64-arm-64bit-Mach-O; real SQLite image fixtures, production single-voter RawNode and Raft Engine, injected filesystem sync gates, four SIGKILL child-process cuts; serial ordinary integration targets; debug assertions enabled; isolated checkout target; debuginfo=0
limitations: This is partial implementation evidence, not MR-06 completion. LTX payloads are produced from real SQLite fixture deltas rather than the pending private command/capture adapter. Private command transactions, persistent receipts, client sequence/expiry floors and speculative-state rebuilding remain required. Only apply_marker_crash_cut from the seven planned MR-06 gates is covered. Command/SDK/query serving, S3 archive/restore, physical power loss and production performance/capacity remain unqualified. The ignored child entry point runs through its parent.

additional_check_results.publication: Held engine sync leaves the old durable marker and public head unchanged. A prepared generation cannot be published or replaced by a second pending apply until its exact marker is durably accepted.
additional_check_results.identity: Entry/ticket identity, the exact committed cache entry, contiguous applied prefix, group/schema digest and LTX base precede image preparation. An unrelated Entry cannot trigger serialization before comparison to the bounded durable entry.
additional_check_results.recovery: A committed update whose image was prepared before shutdown replays from the engine-selected old image. A newer orphan does not become the current head.
additional_check_results.process_faults: Four child kills: after image sealing but before apply completion; before engine marker fsync; after engine marker fsync but before cache/publication completion; after publication. Before fsync either coherent prefix is permitted; after successful fsync the new verified image must recover. Every recovered head matches its engine marker and image digest.
additional_check_results.regressions: 61 passed across native_raft_contract (6), native_raft_ltx (15), native_raft_runtime (14), native_raft_storage (10), native_raft_transport (9), native_replication (6) and native_storage (1). Four ignored helpers are invoked by their parent tests.
additional_check_results.checks: Cellar library/native_raft_execution Clippy with warnings denied, formatting, layout, dependency policy, documentation and all 17 planning-tool cases passed. Existing vendored Raft warnings remain in the raw logs.
